🇮🇸 Iceland reminds us that living with nature is not about conquering it, but learning to adapt.
From volcanic eruptions to the Northern Lights, which part of Iceland's story fascinated you the most? We'd love to hear your thoughts! 🌍
If you enjoyed this journey, your likes, comments, and support help us continue exploring extraordinary places around the world. Thank you for being part of our journey! ❤

comments.author: @peterfillippsss
comments.text:
Wow, what a well put together documentary on a very special place in our World.
Hello again Epic Earth and many thanks for your hard work, it was brilliant. Thank you for your reply to my comment on the Cape Verde documentary, i was glad to hear you are well.
So many highlights in this Iceland presentation, where to begin. I have always loved watching volcanoes erupt and seeing lava flow from the craters on tv. I think it is on my bucket list of things i want to experience in real life. 
Those Northern lights are spectacular as are the rivers of Ice. 
Such a long history of settlement. One can only imagine how hard life would have been in the early years settling the area.
I think the highlight for me was the Hallgrimskirkja Church as i also love architecture, coming from a building background. What an impressive building. I wonder what people will be thinking when the gaze upon it in a few centuries time. 

My day was very fulfilling working with and in Nature today and then to come home and be able to watch your documentaries was the icing on the cake. 
I really liked what you stated at the end, regarding we cannot conquer Mother Nature, we must adapt and learn to live with what she presents to us in the small amount of time that we have as her guest. Well that`s how i see it anyway. 

Great to hear from you again Epic Earth, take care of yourself, kind regards

replies.author: @EpicEarthYTB
replies.text:
Hello my friend! Seeing your comment is always the absolute highlight of my week! 😊 I am so glad to hear you had a fulfilling day working in and with Nature—there is truly no better feeling than an honest day of labor outdoors, and I'm deeply humbled that Epic Earth could be the 'icing on the cake' for your evening.

I love that your building background gave you such a unique appreciation for Hallgrímskirkja! Its design, inspired by Iceland’s volcanic basalt columns, is a masterclass in architecture paying homage to geology. I have no doubt that people will gaze up at it centuries from now with that exact same sense of wonder. And seeing a volcanic eruption in person is truly a primal, humbling spectacle—I sincerely hope you get to cross that off your bucket list one day!

Your reflection on being 'guests of Mother Nature' captured the very heartbeat of this documentary. Learning to adapt with humility rather than trying to conquer is a lesson humanity needs now more than ever.

Thank you for your warmth, your wisdom, and your steadfast loyalty. Please take great care of yourself, enjoy your days in nature, and see you on our next adventure! Warmest regards as always! 🌋❄🌾✨
